products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 is one of the best alternatives from the Spanish brand. This new feature includes the new JACQUARD carbon, which greatly increases durability.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.

products.description:
WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE - Las nuevas zapatillas de pádel perfectas para el día a día. Puedes usarlas tanto de forma casual como para uso intensivo en pista. Wilson Padel ha lanzado su nueva línea de calzado de pádel para la temporada 2026. Estas nuevas WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE son un modelo básico en color blanco, estilo vintage, una apuesta segura dentro de la gama media de Wilson. Este modelo está pensado para ofrecer al jugador un alto comfort y estabilidad.

Incorporan tecnologías avanzadas, como La suela de goma Duralast, con un tipo de patrón similar al clay, optimizado para pádel, el cual nos proporciona tracción constante en pista, ayudando a realizar cambios de dirección más controlados y desplazamientos estables.

These new WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE are a basic model in white, vintage style, a safe bet within Wilson's mid-range. This model is designed to offer the player high comfort and stability.

products.title: Drop Shot Revenge Pro - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO - Versatility, power and control in a mold created by the first Conquerors of magician Juan Lartín Díaz. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot brings us reissues of its most legendary padel rackets, such as this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO, a racket in offensive format, with great punch and a sweet spot with which to keep up with the pace of the match.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO is made for advanced or professional level players. Offensive players with good finishing who get the most out of this model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO make it one of the highest quality Drop Shot paddles. Its format is teardrop, which gives us greater punch and aggressiveness in our blows. However, its balance is spectacular, feeling comfortable and easy to handle.

In its construction, Drop Shot uses 360 curved triaxial carbon on the face of the racket, a premium material in high-end padel rackets that achieves great touch and punch in our shots. Its frame incorporates double carbon tubular for greater durability.

For the core, Drop Shot uses quality high-rebound Eva Soft rubber, which provides optimal precision and ball feel to give everything in our matches and have exceptional control along with a great punch.

The rough touch appears on the faces, which improves the effects of our sliced ​​shots, thanks to the 3D rhomboid-shaped texture, patented by Drop Shot.

It incorporates an anti-vibrator in the heart of the racket, to reduce vibrations to a minimum and a silicone piece that is inserted into the handle of the racket, to improve vibrations even further if possible.

BLADE DESIGN

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO opts for a design in striking colors such as red, black and fluorescent yellow for the logo. A sensational choice by Drop Shot.

PLAY STYLE

The recommended playing style of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO are those styles with aggressiveness and punch in the blows, but with a good feeling of control.

products.title: Wilson Defy Ls V1 2025 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON DEFY LS V1 2025 - A good weapon for punchers, lightness, elegant style and aggressive roughness. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The Wilson Defy Ls v1 2025 is a racket with a very outstanding design, with matte gold and black tones. It stands out for its roughness and its weight of 355 grams. 

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is indicated for advanced level players who like to hit the ball and at the same time give it a lot of spin on topspin and slices.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Defy Ls V1 has a diamond-shaped mold, optimal for a high and fast ball game. Manufactured with different thickness of holes (I-Beam system) facilitating its handling and air passage. Its light weight (355g) and medium-high balance make it a very interesting option for attacking players. The frame is made of carbon, giving it a lot of consistency and its faces are made of CONFORT FLEX Fiberglass, generating high comfort in different hits. Inside we have Power Foam, a compound that exceptionally absorbs the vibration of the impact of the ball, highly recommended for cases of epicondylitis. 

PLAY STYLE

Due to its composition we can affirm that the racket, in addition to being manageable and light, surprises in its response to high balls, vipers and hits. If spin attacks are your thing, don't miss this opportunity, the Defy Ls leaves no one indifferent.
